title: A Bounded Evaluation Protocol for Representational Systematicity
summary: On a controlled semantic-parsing testbed, the protocol classified role–filler binding as causal-use and the declared geometry explanation as unsupported within its searched space, with calibration and seed checks.
ai_technology: Bounded-RS protocol with matched counterfactual tests and causal interventions on fine-tuned T5 models
